properties.title: Peace in Ukraine won’t end Russian sabotage in Europe, Poland warns
properties.description: A peace deal in Ukraine wouldn’t end Russia’s sabotage campaign against Europe, the minister overseeing Poland’s intelligence services has warned. Russian covert operations have intensified in recent months, Tomasz Siemoniak said in an interview Monday, describing how operatives have expanded beyond setting fires at warehouses and shopping centers to targeting railways, communications equipment and defense facilities. Some of the attacks aim to disrupt supplies to Ukraine, he said, but Moscow also wants to intimidate European governments and weaken NATO — objectives that would remain even if the war between Ukraine and Russia ends. “It is hard to imagine that a peace agreement would change the Russian leadership’s stance or stop it from carrying out these operations,” Siemoniak said.

properties.title: Finland summons Russian ambassador over suspected helicopter incursion
properties.description: The Finnish Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Moscow’s ambassador to Helsinki Monday afternoon over its suspicions a Russian helicopter violated Finnish airspace Saturday. The Russian helicopter was sighted at the southern coastal town of Loviisa shortly after midday. The Ministry of Defense said the aircraft encroached on Finland’s territory by some 4.1 kilometers. “Russia’s dangerous and reckless actions in Europe are unacceptable,” the foreign ministry said in a statement on X. “We strongly condemn Russia’s illegal war of aggression and its escalating strikes against civilian targets in Ukraine. properties.title: Europeans dare to believe Trump could deliver security for Ukraine
properties.description: BERLIN — The proposal from U.S. President Donald Trump’s negotiating team to give Ukraine a NATO-style collective defense guarantee has triggered an unusual new mindset among some of Kyiv’s allies in Europe: optimism. properties.title: Russian ship damaged by drone attack in Gulf of Finland, Helsinki and Moscow say
properties.description: A cargo ship sailing under the Russian flag was damaged by a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday morning, the defense ministry in Helsinki said . Finnish authorities said at a press conference Saturday afternoon that Ukraine carried out the attack in international waters, and that the ship then drifted into Finnish territorial waters in the Eastern Gulf of Finland, according to Yle . Authorities also said that the ship is known to have links with the Russian armed forces, but that it could not be confirmed whether military equipment was on board. Russian state-owned news agency Tass said the vessel was transporting “paints and coatings,” citing a single unnamed source . properties.title: Tusk: Russian cruise missile incursion into Poland seems ‘intentional’
properties.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Friday that Russian projectiles entering his country’s territory appeared to be part of an “intentional provocation” from Moscow, hours after U.S. President Donald Trump characterized earlier Russian incursions as happening by “mistake.” One object exploded, but no one was hurt and there was no damage, Tusk said at a press conference. The incursion occurred as Russia launched a massive missile and drone assault on Ukraine , killing at least five people and damaging three major bridges in Kyiv. “This doesn’t look like an accident,” Tusk said, adding that he was choosing his words carefully because the matter was serious. properties.description: <p>Polish PM calls strikes, which took place amid western military exercises, ‘an intentional provocation’ by Moscow</p><p>Two Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone are reported to have crashed in Poland during Russian air attacks on Ukraine that took place amid major western military exercises by allied countries.</p><p>Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said it was “one of the largest attacks” since the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022, with at least eight people killed and nearly 30 injured in Ukraine.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/russian-missiles-drone-poland-attacks-ukraine">Continue reading...</a>

properties.title: Russia hits 3 Kyiv bridges in major attack, while Poland reports airspace violation
properties.description: Russia launched a massive missile and drone attack on Ukraine overnight, killing at least five people and damaging three of Kyiv’s main bridges across the Dnipro River — while Poland reported a violation of its airspace. The strikes came hours after U.S. President Donald Trump called into a meeting of Ukraine’s European allies from Air Force One and said Russian President Vladimir Putin was serious about peace negotiations.
